subject: Merchant record creation: invoice URN and PO mandates
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@taurusenergy.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Procurement Portal <procurement@taurusenergy.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@taurusenergy.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier registration & invoice requirements for Redwood

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this — we're starting vendor setup for Redwood in our AP system and I wanted to share Taurus' standard onboarding packet and a couple of asks up front so we can accept invoices smoothly once you start billing. Please see the attached TAURUS_AP_ONBOARDING_TEMPLATE.xlsx.

Key items we need confirmed before vendor record creation:
- Primary invoice reference: we require PO number in the "InvoiceReference" field and an Invoice URN (external invoice identifier) that we can use for e-invoice reconciliation.
- File delivery: do you plan to use SFTP push or Peppol/e-invoice (UBL)? Our pilot prefers e-invoice but we can accept SFTP CSV.
- Remit instructions: bank account + Swift/IBAN and beneficiary name.
- Tax evidence: VAT/TIN and W-8/W-9 where applicable for US vendors.

If you can reply with the preferred delivery method, sample header mapping (InvoiceReference -> PO#, ExternalInvoiceId -> URN?), and a remit document or vendor packet, I’ll have our vendor team create the record and send the portal invite.

Appreciate it — we have a go-live target of July 5th for PO issuance.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
Taurus Energy

Attachment: TAURUS_AP_ONBOARDING_TEMPLATE.xlsx (xlsx, 210KB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@taurusenergy.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier registration & invoice requirements for Redwood

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the template. We're excited to get this moving. Quick answers up front and then a couple of bits we need from your side.

Delivery method: Redwood can support both e-invoice (UBL/Peppol) and SFTP CSV push. For immediate go-live we recommend SFTP with a simple CSV export while we onboard Peppol; Peppol will reduce reconciliation overhead long term.

Invoice URN / PO mapping: we propose the following mapping:
- InvoiceReference -> Taurus PO# (required)
- ExternalInvoiceId -> RedwoodInvoiceURN (we will send a unique URN on all invoices, format: redwood:INV:YYYYMMDD:NNNN)
- Currency -> ISO 4217 code (USD)

Remit and tax: attached is our standard vendor packet (redwood_vendor_enrollment.pdf) which contains legal name, tax IDs, and sample bank mandate. Note: Redwood is US tax resident; our TIN is 12-3456789 and we'll provide a completed W-9 for US payments or W-8 if a different entity.

Outstanding from your side:
1) Do you require a single-line invoice per PO or are multi-line invoices (itemized) acceptable?
2) If you push via SFTP, can you confirm filename convention and whether you need a header row mapped to specific field names?

I'll loop in Laura (AP) and Ben (payments) to provide the CSV header sample and bank details.

Thanks — I can get the completed W-9 and our bank mandate over by Monday.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_vendor_enrollment.pdf (pdf, 85KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@taurusenergy.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier registration & invoice requirements for Redwood

Hi Elena — Laura here (AP). Thanks Rachel and Elena. Below is the CSV / header mapping we've used successfully with other enterprise customers; happy to tweak. I'm attaching a sample CSV export so you can test import.

Suggested CSV header mapping (first row header names):
- invoice_date -> InvoiceDate (YYYY-MM-DD)
- invoice_number -> ExternalInvoiceId (URN)
- po_number -> InvoiceReference (PO#)
- net_amount -> NetAmount (decimal)
- tax_amount -> TaxAmount (decimal)
- gross_amount -> TotalAmount (decimal)
- currency -> Currency (ISO 4217)
- supplier_id -> SupplierID (our vendor id; optional)
- remit_bank -> RemitBankName
- remit_iban -> RemitIBAN
- remit_swift -> RemitSWIFT
- vat_number -> VATNumber

Peppol/UBL fields (if you go that route):
- InvoiceReference should map to <cac:OrderReference> or <cbc:BuyerReference> depending on schema
- ExternalInvoiceId should map to <cbc:ID> (Invoice) and we will store as the URN

Single-line vs itemized: we can accept both. If you prefer single-line summary invoices for subscription/usage billing, indicate that in the portal and we'll set PO tolerance accordingly. For project-based or professional services POs we'll expect itemized lines.

SFTP: If you choose SFTP push, recommended filename convention: TAURUS_REDWOOD_INV_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv and include header row exactly as the mapping above. We can accept gzipped CSVs.

Bank details and tax evidence: we will submit bank mandate separately via secure form — our accounting team prefers DocuSign for the mandate. Attached: redwood_invoice_mapping_sample.csv (sample).

Let me know if you want a short test file (I can send a 3-row sample tomorrow).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_invoice_mapping_sample.csv (csv, 2KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Quick note — if Taurus requires VAT self-cert for EU entities, Marcus please confirm whether we should supply a copy of the EU VAT self-cert or stick to the W-9. For US-based Taurus entity this will be W-9 + bank mandate.

Ben

(Will follow up with the bank mandate DocuSign link once Rachel confirms the recipient name.)

From: Elena Morales <elena@taurusenergy.com>

Subject: Re: Supplier registration & invoice requirements for Redwood

Hi Rachel / Laura — thanks for the fast turnaround and the sample files. We've created a vendor record in our procurement system for Redwood (vendor ID TE-543210) and invited your onboarding contact to the vendor portal. Next steps:

1) Portal invite: you'll receive an invite from procurement@taurusenergy.com with a one-time activation link. Please accept and complete the remit and tax upload forms.
2) Bank mandate: we'll send a DocuSign request for the bank mandate and remit confirmation — please sign to expedite payment setup.
3) Test file: once you accept the portal invite, please upload a single-row CSV following Laura's headers; we'll run an import on Monday and confirm mapping.

POs will be issued starting 2027-07-05. For now, we'll accept single-line invoices for subscription invoices; itemized invoices will be required when the PO includes line-level quantities.

I'll also attach our vendor setup checklist in a follow-up email.

Best,
Elena
Senior Procurement Manager
Taurus Energy
